# WS-A packet queue — public-API curation (generated by packet A0)

Work-lists come from `docs/API_CURATION_REPORT.md` (regenerate with

## Shared rules for every A-packet (A1–A9)

- BASE: the current WS integration branch (core-decomp2/a0 until merged; then main).
- DEAD types: the report's "dead" verdict means "no word-boundary reference
  outside the declaring file(s), excluding markdown/json". Before deleting,
  RE-VERIFY each name with an unrestricted grep (`git grep -w <Name>` — no
  pathspec excludes) and check for string-keyed use (Codable containers,
  NSClassFromString, #keyPath, storyboard/plist, JS/TS bridges). If a re-check
  finds a live use, reclassify (leave it, note it in the packet's converged-
  reality section) — do NOT force the deletion.
- OWN-MODULE-ONLY types: flip `public|open` -> `internal` (drop the keyword) on
  the type AND its members. If the compiler then reports an unseen cross-module
  use, revert that symbol and note it.
- TEST-ONLY types are WAIT-FOR-WS-B (per-module `@testable` is the point of
  WS-B); only packet A9 touches them, and only after WS-B lands.
- Ratchet etiquette: `check-public-api-budget.sh` shrink is NON-FATAL. Run
  `--update` and commit budgets/public-api-baseline.json in the SAME PR only if
  no sibling A-packet is in flight for the same modules; otherwise leave the
  baseline alone and let the integrator land the per-wave ratchet-down PR
  (mirrors the membership-gate protocol). Deleting whole files also shrinks the
  membership budget — likewise non-fatal.
- V-list (full, every packet): `cd OpenBurnBarCore && swift build && swift test`;
  daemon build (`cd OpenBurnBarDaemon && swift build`, then revert any
  Package.resolved pin drift — see K1 OP-NOTE); Linux-boundary composition
  build on the CORE package (`cd OpenBurnBarCore &&
  OPENBURNBAR_DAEMON_LINUX_BOUNDARY_BUILD=1 swift build` — running the flag
  against the OpenBurnBarDaemon package instead fails on CSQLite resolution
  by design: WPD-0005 prunes GRDB-SQLCipher/CSQLite from that composition);
  ALL scripts/debt gates;
  `scripts/ci/check-no-suppressions.sh`;
  `node tools/ipc/generate-burnbarrpc-canon.mjs --check`; scope diff vs base.
- PR: label `codex`, full validation matrix in body, never merge yourself.
